tools.name: analyze_heapsnapshot_contexts
tools.description: Loads and caches a memory heapsnapshot to identify and rank closure contexts holding dead captured fields—variables no remaining live closure can read. Scopes are ranked globally by the retained size of these dead values to provide a prioritizing heuristic, rather than an exact measure of reclaimable bytes.

filePath.description: A path to a .heapsnapshot file to read.

retainedSize.description: Inclusive range for the dead-field score of a context (e.g. "10KB", "1MB-2MB", "-1MB", or "1MB-"). A single value is treated as a minimum.

scopeInfoNodeId.description: Only return contexts declared by the scope with this ScopeInfo node id, as reported in the scope header of a previous call.

maxNameLength.description: Maximum length of names before truncation. Defaults to 100.

pageIdx.description: The zero-based page index. Defaults to 0 (the first page).

pageSize.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: configure_webauthn
tools.description: Adds a virtual WebAuthn authenticator to the page. Call this before the page calls navigator.credentials. It answers navigator.credentials.create() and get() and is removed when the page closes. Omitted parameters keep their current values. Changing protocol, transport, hasResidentKey or hasUserVerification replaces the authenticator and deletes its credentials. enabled=false ignores other parameters and removes all authenticators on the page.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

enabled.description: Set to false to remove all virtual authenticators from the page.

transport.description: "internal" is a platform authenticator such as Touch ID or Windows Hello; the others are roaming security keys. Default: internal.

hasResidentKey.description: Whether the authenticator can store discoverable credentials (passkeys). Default: true. u2f does not support it, so it is false for u2f.

hasUserVerification.description: Whether the authenticator supports user verification (PIN or biometrics). Default: true. u2f does not support it, so it is false for u2f.

isUserVerified.description: Whether user verification succeeds. Set to false to test a failed verification. Default: true.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag an element onto another element

from_uid.description: The uid of the element to drag

to_uid.description: The uid of the element to drop into

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: emulate
tools.description: Emulates various features on the target page. Each call replaces all emulation settings (except extraHttpHeaders), so pass all desired settings in a single call.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

geolocation.description: Geolocation (`<latitude>,<longitude>`) to emulate. Latitude between -90 and 90. Longitude between -180 and 180. Omit to clear the geolocation override.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Omit or set to empty string to clear the user agent override.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

forcedColors.description: Emulate the `forced-colors` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

prefersContrast.description: Emulate the `prefers-contrast` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

prefersReducedMotion.description: Emulate the `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

viewport.description: Emulate device viewports '<width>x<height>x<devicePixelRatio>[,mobile][,touch][,landscape]'. 'touch' and 'mobile' to emulate mobile devices. 'landscape' to emulate landscape mode. Omit to clear the viewport override.

extraHttpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as a JSON string object, e.g. {"X-Custom": "value", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}. Headers are included into every HTTP request originating from the page and persist across navigations until cleared. Pass an empty string to clear all extra headers.

tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript inside the target page. The source can be provided inline or loaded from a local file. Returns the response as JSON, so returned values have to be JSON-serializable.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

function.description:
JavaScript source to execute in the target page. Provide either this or sourcePath, but not both. The source is interpreted according to format.
Example without arguments: `() => document.title` or `async () => await fetch("example.com")`.
Example with arguments: `(el) => el.innerText`

sourcePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a JavaScript file on the MCP server's local filesystem. Provide either this or function, but not both.

format.description: How to interpret the source. "function" treats it as a function declaration and supports args. "script" evaluates it as classic JavaScript and does not support args. Defaults to "function". ECMAScript modules are not supported.

args.description: An optional list of arguments (element uids from the page content snapshot) to pass to the function.

items.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

filePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a file to save the script output to. If omitted, the output is returned inline.

dialogAction.description: Handle dialogs while execution. "accept", "dismiss", or string for response of window.prompt. Defaults to accept.

waitForStableDom.description: Whether to wait for the DOM to settle. Pass false if the script only reads data. Defaults to true.

tools.name: get_css_styles
tools.description:
Retrieve matched CSS rules, inline styles (element.style), inherited styles, custom properties, and cascade wrappers (@layer, @media, @container, @scope) for an element identified by its UID.
Rules are ordered from highest to lowest cascade precedence and include source line numbers (e.g. index:196). Active (winning) declarations have no prefix tag, while (losing) overridden declarations are prefixed with [overloaded].
Treat the output as authoritative and complete.
Results are paginated (10 rules per page by default); use pageIdx to page through the remaining rules. Requires a UID from take_snapshot.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of the element on the page from the page content snapshot to inspect CSS styles for

pageSize.description: Maximum number of CSS rules to return per page. Defaults to 10.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). Defaults to 0 (the first page).

tools.name: list_3p_developer_tools
tools.description:
Lists all third-party developer tools the page exposes for providing runtime information (including debugging WebMCP tools and tools exposed via the 'devtoolstooldiscovery' event).
Third-party developer tools can be called via the 'execute_3p_developer_tool()' MCP tool.
Alternatively, third-party developer tools exposed via the 'devtoolstooldiscovery' event can be executed by calling 'evaluate_script' and adding the
following command to the script:
`window.__dtmcp.executeTool(toolName, params)`
This might be helpful when the third-party developer tools return non-serializable values or when composing
third-party developer tools with additional functionality.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

tools.name: list_console_messages
tools.description: List all console messages for the target page since the last navigation.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, returns all messages.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page. Ignored unless pageSize is set.

types.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includeStackTraces.description: Set to true to include the stack trace for each message when available. Increases the response size.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set to true to return the preserved requests over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: list_pages

tools.name: list_webmcp_tools
tools.description: Lists all WebMCP tools the page exposes (excluding debugging tools, which are exposed via 'list_3p_developer_tools').

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

tools.name: mock_network
tools.description: Inspect or update network mocks for a page. With no actions, list mocks matching the supplied filters, or all mocks when no filters are given. Providing body or upstream updates the exact route/resourceType pair. An omitted route matches any URL. Other mocks are preserved. The most recently updated matching mock wins and persists across navigations. Configure before navigating or reloading; inspection shows hit counts and replacement errors. Upstream responses use server-side GET/HEAD fetches. Changes are rejected during a performance trace. Mocks disable the page HTTP cache and intercept every request, affecting measurements. Service workers can bypass mocks. Use remove_network_mock to remove mocks.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

route.description: Absolute URLPattern, e.g. https://example.com/app.js or `*://*:*/app.js`. Use `*` for wildcards; omitted query strings match any query. Regex and `:name` groups are rejected. Inspection and removal compare the stored pattern exactly. Omit to inspect/remove all routes or match any URL.

resourceType.description: Restrict requests and stored mock filters to this resource type. Omit to inspect/remove all types or configure a mock for any type.

body.description: Local response body file, revalidated and reread for every request. Content-Type follows its extension. Mutually exclusive with upstream.

upstream.description: Absolute HTTP(S) replacement URL for GET/HEAD requests. URL allowlists and blocklists apply to this URL and every redirect. Mutually exclusive with body.

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.description: Go to a URL, or back, forward, or reload. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

handleBeforeUnload.description: Whether to auto accept or beforeunload dialogs triggered by this navigation. Default is accept.

initScript.description: A JavaScript script to be executed on each new document before any other scripts for the next navigation.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: new_page
tools.description: Open a new tab and load a URL. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

background.description: Whether to open the page in the background without bringing it to the front. Default is false (foreground).

isolatedContext.description: If specified, the page is created in an isolated browser context with the given name. Pages in the same browser context share cookies and storage. Pages in different browser contexts are fully isolated (useful for clean-slate testing of cookies and authentication).

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: performance_analyze_insight
tools.description: Provides more detailed information on a specific Performance Insight of an insight set that was highlighted in the results of a trace recording.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

insightSetId.description: The id for the specific insight set. Only use the ids given in the "Available insight sets" list.

insightName.description: The name of the Insight you want more information on. For example: "DocumentLatency" or "LCPBreakdown"

tools.name: performance_start_trace
tools.description: Start a performance trace on the target webpage. Use to find frontend performance issues, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), and improve page load speed.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

reload.description: Determines if, once tracing has started, the target page should be automatically reloaded. Navigate the page to the right URL using the navigate_page tool BEFORE starting the trace if reload or autoStop is set to true.

autoStop.description: Determines if the trace recording should be automatically stopped.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to bypass the HTTP cache when reloading the page, to measure a cold page load. Only applies if reload is true. Active network mocks always disable the page HTTP cache.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

tools.name: performance_stop_trace
tools.description: Stop the active performance trace recording on the target webpage.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key or key combination. Use this when other input methods like fill() cannot be used (e.g., keyboard shortcuts, navigation keys, or special key combinations). Note: On macOS, native <select> elements cannot be operated with ArrowDown/Enter via press_key; use fill() on the combobox or click() on the option instead.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

key.description: A key or a combination (e.g., "Enter", "Control+A", "Control++", "Control+Shift+R"). Modifiers: Control, Shift, Alt, Meta

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: query_heapsnapshot_objects
tools.description: Loads and caches a memory heapsnapshot and queries objects matching specific filters (className, propertyName, nodeType, retainedSize, selfSize, isDetached, sortBy).

filePath.description: A path to a .heapsnapshot file to read.

className.description: Optional regex or text matching object class name.

propertyName.description: Optional property name filter for outgoing reference edges.

nodeType.description: Optional V8 node type filter (e.g. object, closure, string, array, code).

retainedSize.description: Inclusive retained size range (e.g. "1MB-2MB", "-1MB", or "1MB-"). A single value is treated as a minimum.

selfSize.description: Inclusive self size range (e.g. "1MB-2MB", "-1MB", or "1MB-"). A single value is treated as a minimum.

isDetached.description: Whether to filter for detached DOM nodes.

sortBy.description: Sort order for results. Default is retainedSize.

pageIdx.description: The zero-based page index. Defaults to 0 (the first page).

pageSize.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50.

maxNameLength.description: Maximum length of names before truncation. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: reload_extension
tools.description: Reloads an unpacked Chrome extension by its ID.

id.description: ID of the extension to reload.

tools.name: remove_network_mock
tools.description: Remove network mocks matching the supplied stored route and/or resource type. Route patterns are compared exactly, not applied as wildcards to other patterns. Omit both filters to remove all mocks for the page. Removing the last mock restores the HTTP cache and stops interception. Changes are rejected during a performance trace.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

route.description: Absolute URLPattern, e.g. https://example.com/app.js or `*://*:*/app.js`. Use `*` for wildcards; omitted query strings match any query. Regex and `:name` groups are rejected. Inspection and removal compare the stored pattern exactly. Omit to inspect/remove all routes or match any URL.

resourceType.description: Restrict requests and stored mock filters to this resource type. Omit to inspect/remove all types or configure a mock for any type.

tools.name: resize_page
tools.description: Resizes the page's window so that the page has specified dimension

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

filePath.description: Output file path (.mp4). Uses mkdtemp to generate a unique path if not provided.

tools.name: screencast_stop
tools.description: Stops the active screencast recording on the target page.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

tools.name: select_page

bringToFront.description: Whether to focus the page and bring it to the top.

tools.name: set_logpoints
tools.description: Set the complete set of logpoints of the selected page: logpoints not in the list are removed, new ones are added, and an empty list removes all. A logpoint logs expressions to the console every time a line executes, without pausing or changing the source, like logpoints in the DevTools Sources panel. Locations are script URLs or original source files resolved through source maps (not available with --no-source-maps; scripts in workers and out-of-process iframes are not supported). A location in a generated script moves to its original source line when a source map covers it, and locations on the same line become one logpoint with the last expression. Output appears in list_console_messages; an expression that throws produces an error message without text. Logpoints survive reloads and navigations until removed or the page is closed. The response lists the resulting logpoints and where they are bound.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

logpoints.description: Logpoints formatted as <url>:<lineNumber>[:<columnNumber>] <expression>. The url is a script URL or the path of an original source file from a source map, exact or as a path suffix (e.g. "src/app.ts"). Line and column numbers are 1-based in the coordinates of the url; a line without executable code moves to the next possible location. The expression is evaluated like console.log() arguments in the scope of the location, where local variables are accessible by their original names, and runs before the line executes, so a variable declared on that line is not set yet. list_console_messages shows objects as [object Object]: read them with get_console_message, or log JSON.stringify(value) for plain data. Example: "src/cart.ts:42 'cart total:', cart.total, cart.items.length". Pass an empty array to remove all logpoints.

tools.name: take_heapsnapshot
tools.description: Capture a heap snapshot of the target page. Use to analyze the memory distribution of JavaScript objects and debug memory leaks.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

filePath.description: A path to a .heapsnapshot file to save the heapsnapshot to.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png"

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG and WebP formats (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot. If omitted, takes a page screenshot.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description:
Take a text snapshot of the target page based on the a11y tree. The snapshot lists page elements along with a unique
identifier (uid). Always use the latest snapshot. Prefer taking a snapshot over taking a screenshot. The snapshot indicates the element selected
in the DevTools Elements panel (if any).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

verbose.description: Whether to include all possible information available in the full a11y tree. Default is false.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the snapshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: trigger_extension_action
tools.description: Triggers the default action of an extension by its ID.

id.description: ID of the extension to trigger the action for.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text using keyboard into a previously focused input

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

submitKey.description: Optional key to press after typing. E.g., "Enter", "Tab", "Escape"

tools.name: uninstall_extension
tools.description: Uninstalls a Chrome extension by its ID.

id.description: ID of the extension to uninstall.

tools.name: uninstall_pwa
tools.description: Uninstalls a Progressive Web App identified by its manifest ID and closes any open app windows.

manifestId.description: The manifest ID of the web app: the resolved `id` member of its manifest. If `id` is omitted, it defaults to the resolved `start_url` (e.g. "https://example.com/"). See https://w3c.github.io/manifest/#id-member.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file through a provided element.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of the file input element or an element that will open file chooser on the page from the page content snapshot

filePaths.description: One or more files paths to upload. File paths have to be local to the browser instance (not the MCP).

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page. By default, hidden text is also matched. Set visible to true to wait until the matched text is visible.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

text.description: Non-empty list of texts. Resolves when any value matches an accessible name exactly or is a substring of DOM text. Matching is case-sensitive. DOM text preserves spaces and newlines, unlike snapshot text which may normalize whitespace. Use the original whitespace or a shorter distinctive substring.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

visible.description: If true, wait until the matching text is visible. By default, hidden text also counts.
